bio: Here the enjoyment begins with the magnificent location right by Wörthersee – on balmy summer evenings, you can experience many a beautiful sunset over the lake from the marvellous terrace! Inside, a plush, modern and elegant interior in a palette of light, warm colours awaits you. Service is organised in the classical way and the brigade is friendly and professional. The food is billed as Austrian-Mediterranean cuisine and Hubert Wallner and team are inspired by the Alpine region. There are two set menus comprising five to seven courses, plus a few excellent extras before, in between and after. À la carte options are also available.
